site.name: ArtCraft Studio
site.description: One desktop workspace for ten Rust creative apps: photo, vector, video, writing, decks, layout, effects, RAW, spreadsheets and PDF.

faq.question: What is ArtCraft Studio?
faq.answer: ArtCraft Studio is a Rust and Tauri desktop shell that runs the official browser builds of ten Storytold creative apps in one window: PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, DesignCraft, EffectCraft, LightCraft, GridCraft and PDFCraft.

faq.question: Is ArtCraft Studio free and open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The shell is released under the Apache-2.0 licence, and the ten upstream apps are open-source projects maintained by Storytold.

faq.question: Does ArtCraft Studio work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. Each app build is downloaded at build time, checksum-verified, and bundled into the installer, so the suite does not need network access at runtime.

faq.question: Which operating systems does ArtCraft Studio support?
faq.answer: Windows installers (NSIS and MSI) are built today. The Tauri codebase targets macOS and Linux as well, but those installers are not part of the current release.

faq.question: How do AI agents connect to the suite?
faq.answer: The repository publishes an A2A Agent Card for discovery, an aggregated Model Context Protocol server exposing app guides and suite tools, and a local JSONL notification log that agents can read.

apps.name: PhotoCraft
apps.tagline: Layered raster editing with real PSD files.
apps.description: PhotoCraft is an open-source image editor with layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors and brushes, and it opens and saves real PSD files.

faq.question: Does PhotoCraft open PSD files?
faq.answer: Yes. PhotoCraft reads and writes real PSD files, including layers, masks, layer styles and editable type.

faq.question: Is PhotoCraft a Photoshop replacement?
faq.answer: It is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Photoshop's editing model rather than a byte-for-byte clone, so some advanced PSD features may still differ.

apps.name: VectorCraft
apps.tagline: Precision vector illustration, built in Rust.
apps.description: VectorCraft is an open-source vector art application for Bezier illustration, shape building and clean, scalable artwork, with agent and command-line access.

faq.question: What is VectorCraft used for?
faq.answer: VectorCraft is for vector illustration: drawing and editing Bezier paths, building shapes, and producing artwork that scales cleanly for logos, icons and print.

faq.question: Can AI agents drive VectorCraft?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream project documents use from Claude Code and other agents, and the suite also exposes VectorCraft guidance through its MCP server.

faq.question: Is FilmCraft a full non-linear editor?
faq.answer: Yes. FilmCraft provides a multi-track timeline, trimming, color, effects, motion, audio, titles and captions, and export controls in one editor.

faq.question: Does FilmCraft support color grading?
faq.answer: Yes. Color is a first-class workspace in FilmCraft alongside editing, effects, audio and titles.

apps.name: WordCraft
apps.description: WordCraft is an open-source word processor for writing, page layout and document design, with command-line and MCP access for automated and agent-driven work.

faq.question: What makes WordCraft different from a basic text editor?
faq.answer: WordCraft combines writing with page layout, typography and document design, so long-form documents can be composed and styled in the same place.

faq.question: Can WordCraft be automated?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream project ships a command-line interface and an MCP server, and the suite's MCP server exposes WordCraft guidance to agents.

apps.name: DeckCraft
apps.tagline: Slide decks and presentations, designed in Rust.
apps.description: DeckCraft is an open-source presentation designer for building slide decks and slide shows, with CLI and MCP integration for scripted and agent-driven decks.

faq.question: Can DeckCraft build decks from the command line?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream DeckCraft CLI includes an MCP server mode for headless and agent-driven deck work, and can connect to a running app.

faq.question: Does DeckCraft present full-screen slide shows?
faq.answer: Yes. DeckCraft is a presentation and slide designer with a presentation mode, not only a static document exporter.

faq.question: Is DesignCraft for print or screen?
faq.answer: DesignCraft targets page layout and publishing, including print-oriented documents such as magazines, with typography, frames and multi-page spreads.

faq.question: Does DesignCraft include a sample project?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream repository ships a sample magazine that demonstrates the layout and publishing workflow.

faq.question: Does EffectCraft do 3D?

faq.question: Can agents automate EffectCraft?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream project ships an MCP server that exposes its scene tree, keyframes and rendered frames to agent clients.

faq.answer: Yes. LightCraft is a native, private editor: photos are processed on your machine, and the suite bundles it for offline use.

faq.question: What editing controls does LightCraft offer?
faq.answer: LightCraft covers light, color, effects, tone curves, masking, presets, profiles, the color mixer, crop and geometry, and black-and-white conversion.

faq.question: Is GridCraft built for large data sets?
faq.answer: GridCraft is designed as a high-performance spreadsheet with a native Rust engine and fast grid rendering.

apps.name: PDFCraft
apps.tagline: Read, organize and edit PDF documents.
apps.description: PDFCraft is an open-source PDF workbench for reading, searching, organizing, merging, splitting and annotating documents, including protected files.

faq.question: Can PDFCraft merge and split PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. PDFCraft can combine and split documents and reorganize pages without re-encoding the whole file.

faq.question: Does PDFCraft open protected PDFs?
faq.answer: PDFCraft can open protected documents while respecting their permissions, rather than bypassing them.
